next_step: Begin 2-week hosted POC (streaming + tool-calls) week of 2026-03-22
notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building outbound SDR chat assistants that operate in realtime (low-latency streaming) and must perform CRM/email/calendar actions via tool-calling. Evaluating hosted first to validate UX and latency SLOs, then likely move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and reserved concurrency.

Key quotes / snippets: "We need streaming replies that start under 150ms p50 and 250ms p95 for short replies when agent is live."
"Tool calling must be deterministic — createLead, sendEmail, scheduleMeeting hooks need robust failure/fallback modes."

Technical priorities: streaming token-level partials, tool calling (webhook signing + idempotency), deterministic function outputs for CRM actions, low cold-start latency for model variants, prefix caching for repeated prompts, multi-region routing with US-only data residency.

POC ask: 2-week hosted POC focusing on a simulated SDR workload (50 concurrent agents, bursts to 200), demo runtime streaming + function calling, tooling to exercise CRM/email/calendar actions against sandbox Salesforce + Gmail/Exchange. POC success criteria: p50 streaming < 150ms, p95 < 400ms, function-call success > 99% in sandbox, token-cost estimate within projected budget.

Commercial: Interested in usage-based pricing for hosted; will request Dedicated quotes for committed capacity if POC validates. Top concern: streaming costs at scale and predictable billing for large concurrent sessions. Asking for sample billing model: per-session baseline + per-token during active streaming.

Security & compliance: SOC2 mandatory, SSO/SAML for console, KMS integration for customer keys, audit logs export to SIEM, 90-day retention by default with options. Legal team flagged data residency (US only) and wants evidence of VPC/private deployment for Dedicated.

Integrations: Salesforce (create/update lead/contact, add activity), Gmail + O365 send-email + calendar invites, internal CRM API webhook. SE notes: we should demo function-calling wiring to the Salesforce sandbox and show signed webhook callback with idempotency token (important ask).

Risks: if hosted API streaming < SLA they will push for private on-prem evaluation. Concerned about model drift: wants automated evals on prompt sets tied to quality alerts.

Next steps: schedule 45m tech scoping with SE (Lina) to lock success metrics and test scenarios, set up sandbox credentials, provide pricing model template, and sign standard NDA for sandbox logs.
